description: AbstractActorWithLock is an Akka actor class that manages message handling with locking capabilities, allowing it to temporarily prevent message processing for a specified duration.

classes.name: AbstractActorWithLock
classes.description: An Akka actor class that can lock itself to temporarily prevent message handling, with methods to lock, unlock, and switch message handlers.

methods.name: handleMessage
methods.description: Abstract method to define the actor's message handling logic.

methods.name: setLocked
methods.description: Locks the actor for a specified duration, scheduling an unlock.

methods.name: unlock
methods.description: Unlocks the actor to resume message handling.

methods.name: become
methods.description: Switches the actor's message handler to a new receive function.

methods.name: become
methods.description: Switches the actor's message handler with an option to discard the old handler.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Creates the actor's message receive behavior based on the current handler.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleans up resources when the actor stops, cancelling scheduled unlocks.
